name: eSurveysPro
description_en:
eSurveysPro is a product in the Surveys and feedback category. Its directory profile covers Skip Logic, Survey Templates, Support Audio / Images / Video, Question Library, Question Branching, Online Survey, Multiple Question Types, Mobile Survey.

Additional listed capabilities include Embeddable Survey, Email Distribution, Data Analysis Tools, Custom Survey URLs, 360 Degree Feedback. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large) Individuals. API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Starts at $40.0. Offers Free-forever plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: choose subsequent questions using earlier answers; set supported survey addresses for sharing. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.

资料还列出可嵌入问卷、邮件分发、数据分析工具、自定义问卷链接、360 度反馈。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。
